description: Solar Program Current Incentive Levels and Available Capacity is a dataset listed in City of Austin open data portal (datahub.austintexas.gov), an open data portal (Socrata) of a city, published or maintained by City of Austin. This data can be used to track the capacity and incentive levels available for Austin Energy's Solar Rebate Program. Coverage: Austin. The portal files it under the category Utilities and City Services. Its tags are rebate, solar. The table has 5 columns. Attribution on the portal: City of Austin, Texas - data.austintexas.gov. The portal shows 2021-02-10 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is public domain (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-datahub-austintexas-gov-portal.
